Usage: gacli admin datastreams create [options]

Create a data stream

Options:
  --type <streamType>           Data stream type (WEB_DATA_STREAM,
                                ANDROID_APP_DATA_STREAM, IOS_APP_DATA_STREAM)
  --display-name <name>         Display name for the data stream
  --uri <uri>                   Web stream URI (for WEB_DATA_STREAM)
  --package-name <packageName>  Android package name (for
                                ANDROID_APP_DATA_STREAM)
  --bundle-id <bundleId>        iOS bundle ID (for IOS_APP_DATA_STREAM)
  -h, --help                    display help for command
